corrections.why: Two visitor reports describe cement footings still at the lookout site on the summit ridge, one dated 1934. Ruins means footings or remains only. The FFLA list says gone, so an editor should check this against a site visit or a newer source before publishing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA list says Gone. Idaho Fire Lookouts and WillhiteWeb describe cement footings at the lookout site on the summit ridge, and Forest Lookouts says Removed. Recorded as ruins, with the disagreement noted in the status note.

notes_for_editor: Status is the open question: FFLA says gone, two visitor reports describe footings. The 20-foot observation house from the 1964 NGS description supports the brief's 6.1 m height. Idaho Fire Lookouts says The Wigwams - as Squawman is now named, which can be read as a rename; the USGS quad uses The Wigwams (1996), so the story treats the two as alternate names and does not claim a rename. The Squawman name may need an editor decision. The Idaho Fire Lookouts trip report is dated September 16, 2025 but says the visit was in 2026, so its date is unreliable. Footing evidence rests on visitor reports, not a survey. Gate status is not confirmed. The brief's material 'wood' was not checked against any page read here.
